The main takeaway from our work is that
the best architecture for an FPGA accelerator for a CNN model is not necessarily the one that maximizes the number of operations per second.
the best architecture is not necessarily the one that maximizes the number of layers or the total number of multiply-and-accumulate (MAC) operations.
the best architecture for CNN accelerators depends not only on the CNN model but also on the FPGA platform.
